_arch_note: RAW FastMultiHeadLut FFN (no compress / no decompress ablation), point 1 of the bpb-match search. FFN slot = FastMultiHeadLut(input_dim=384, n_heads=4, n_outputs=384, nap=8/256 cells, tph=128); routing anchors index the full 384-d input; tables emit the full 384-d output directly (heads summed). Raw head-to-head vs grid anchor exp_n_0121 (same H4/nap8/tph128 but CompressionMHL compress48+decompress48). Grid-standard: UNTIED unembedder, n_steps 16000, lr 3e-4, warmup 0.1, device_batch 12/grad_accum 4 (eff batch 24,576), full-anneal cosine. train.py byte-identical to exp_g_0023 (config-gated FFN kind only). WARNING ~302M FFN table params (n_heads*tph*2^nap*384). Target: bpb ~1.20144 (UNTIED VANILLA exp_n_0135); this point likely lands BELOW it (over-capacity), search moves to lower nap/tph to raise bpb to the match.
_fe_note:
FUNCTION-EMITTING CELLS, fourier basis, K=16. Fork of exp_n_0136 (raw FastMultiHeadLut FFN, 1.20567 at 330.7M params) with the routing IDENTICAL -- input_dim 384, n_heads 4, nap 8 (256 cells), tph 128, same anchors, same gather -- and only the cell EMISSION changed. A cell stores basis-function parameters over the output-index axis instead of 384 independent values; its contribution is those functions evaluated at every index.

FOURIER: W[c,i] = dc[c] + sum_n a_cos[c,n] cos(2*pi*n*i/D) + a_sin[c,n] sin(2*pi*n*i/D), frequencies fixed at the harmonics -- 2N+1 = 33 params per cell against 384, 11.64x fewer.

CAVEAT, and it decides what this run can show: with FIXED frequencies the basis matrix is shared by every cell, so sum_c (A[c] @ Phi) = (sum_c A[c]) @ Phi -- the synthesis COMMUTES with the gather-sum. That makes it free to compute, but it also makes the model exactly a CompressionMHL decompress whose Linear is frozen to a DCT/DFT basis. A learned Linear can represent any fixed basis, so on expressiveness this is a strict subset of exp_n_0121 / exp_n_0138. Read it as a compactness point, not a quality point. Setting fe_learn_freq=true makes the frequencies per-cell and breaks the factorisation, at ~2.7x the step cost.

fe_k is the knob to sweep. Measured at this shape: see the smoke numbers in the task report.
